Interactive BFS shortest-path tree explorer

interactive_bfs.Rd

R-native counterpart of graph-tool's interactive BFS visualization (interactive_bst.py), highlighting the shortest-path BFS tree up to depth max_dist from any selected vertex.

Usage

interactive_bfs(graph, pos = NULL, source = 1L, max_dist = 3L,
  directed = NULL, mode = c("html", "locator", "snapshot"), output = NULL,
  width = 760L, height = 560L, highlight_color = "#CE5C00",
  base_color = "#999999", open = FALSE,
  main = "Interactive BFS Tree Explorer")

Arguments

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

pos

Optional \(N \times 2\) vertex layout matrix; computed via sfdp_layout if NULL.

source

1-based integer vertex index (or vector of vertex indices when mode = "snapshot") specifying the initial BFS root(s).

max_dist

Maximum BFS depth to highlight (default 3L, matching graph-tool's interactive_bst.py).

directed

Logical or NULL; defaults to isTRUE(graph$directed).

mode

Interaction mode: "html" writes a standalone zero-dependency HTML5 Canvas web app with live hover/click BFS tree highlighting and depth slider; "locator" runs an interactive base-R click loop via locator; "snapshot" renders static single- or multi-panel BFS tree figure(s).

output

Optional destination HTML path (mode = "html") or PNG file path (mode = "snapshot").

width, height

Canvas or PNG image dimensions in pixels.

highlight_color

Colour for BFS tree edges and reached vertices (default "#CE5C00").

base_color

Colour for non-tree edges and unreached vertices.

open

Logical; if TRUE in an interactive R session with mode = "html", opens the HTML file via browseURL.

main

Title for the viewer or plot.

Details

Platform and display requirements:

  • mode = "html" works headless during generation and runs interactively offline in any modern web browser or RStudio Viewer (hovering updates the BFS tree live; clicking pins or unpins the current root).

  • mode = "locator" requires an interactive R session with a locator-capable graphics device (Quartz, X11, Windows, or RStudioGD); it errors cleanly in non-interactive sessions.

  • mode = "snapshot" works on any R graphics device or writes a PNG file via png when output is supplied.

Value

An object of class "rgraphtool_interactive_bfs" containing bfs (an graph_bfs result), pos, mode, output, max_dist, and directed.

Examples

g <- graph_create(10L, directed = FALSE)
graph_add_edges(g, rbind(cbind(1:9, 2:10), c(1L, 6L)))
set.seed(1)
pos <- sfdp_layout(g, max_iter = 30L)
res <- interactive_bfs(g, pos = pos, source = 1L, max_dist = 3L,
                       mode = "html", output = tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
print(res)
#> rgraphtool interactive BFS visualization
#>   mode: html -> /var/folders/ph/fmqmjzln2h15bm5bstsgpng80000gn/T//RtmpqCUSwG/file15c8c7bddaec4.html
#> rgraphtool BFS traversal
#>   source: 1 (undirected, max_dist = 3)
#>   reached: 8 / 10 vertices (max distance = 3, tree edges = 7)
